script_text: Heads up, Taurus—the cosmos is shifting dramatically today. Venus, your ruling planet, is forming a tight sextile with Neptune in your 12th House of Subconscious, heightening intuition but blurring boundaries. This aspect activates deep emotions, so pay attention to dreams. Meanwhile, Mars squares Saturn in your 8th House, urging caution with shared resources and investments. In love, this sextile could bring a dreamy connection; singles might attract a spiritual partner, while couples should nurture intimacy to avoid misunderstandings. For career, focus on your 10th House where Mercury trines Pluto, signaling powerful negotiations—seize financial opportunities with precision. Avoid impulsive decisions today; a blessing is an unexpected insight from a mentor guiding your path. Follow for tomorrow's reading to stay aligned with the stars.
